```Different Fandoms {1, 2 or 3 Characters Each}!``` (Note: The Ones That Aren't the characters I'm talking about don't count!)

My Hero Academia Characters:

Izuku Midoriya {Deku}: Izuku is a very timid, reserved, and polite boy, frequently overreacting to abnormal situations with exaggerated expressions. His struggle with being Quirkless characterizes Midoriya's background. His early life is marked by bullying, particularly from his childhood friend Katsuki Bakugou {Kacchan}. This adversity shapes his empathetic and resilient nature. His 8 quirks are: One for All. One for All stands as the fundamental Quirk passed down through generations, Blackwhip. Daigoro Banjo, the fifth inheritor of One for All, possessed Blackwhip, Float, Danger, Sense, Smokescreen, Fa Jin, and Gearshift. A running gag is Izuku blushing and getting flustered whenever Ochaco Uraraka {Uravity} happens to be too close to him, hinting that he might have a crush on her. Ochaco is the one who turned his once demeaning nickname "Deku" into a positive identity for him, saying it gave her a "never gives up" vibe. And One More thing: Katsuki calls Izuku: Deku which means: Useless or Wooden figure.

-----------------------------------------------------------

Katsuki Bakugou {Kacchan}: Katsuki begins the series as an intelligent student with aspirations of being the world's greatest hero, but had an arrogant, violent and crude personality. He often bullied Izuku Midoriya with reasons being currently unknown, during their childhood. His Phobia{s} are: Somniphobia- The fear of sleep, Aquaphobia- The fear of drowning, and Phronemophobia- The fear of thinking. Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series. Katsuki tends to come off as unheroic.. He is fiercely independent, adventurous, competitive, and passionate about achieving his goals, which are all qualities that are commonly associated with Aries.

```Hazbin Hotel Character {One}```


Alastor The Radio Demon: Name ("Alastor + Radio demon + Al")
age ("133")
gender ("Male + man")
hight ("7 foot")
looks (Alastor is a slim, dapper sinner demon with beige-colored skin, and usually has a broad smile full of sharp, yellow teeth. He is at around the same height as his rival, Vox, with the two standing at approximately 7 feet + He sports a pinkish-red cropped, angled bob-cut with black tips at the ends and two large, black tipped tufts of hair extending from the top of his head, evoking the ears of a deer. The style has an undercut at the back, and two small black antlers protruding from the crown, which can grow in size in his full demonic form. Alastor's eyes have dark-red sclera, bright-red irises and thin black pupils (which can change into the shape of radio dials when shifting into his full demon form). His forearms and lower legs fade to dark grey, and he has red hoofed toes and red fingers. + Alastor wears a red pinstripe coat with dark-red lapels piped with white, which is ragged along the bottom hem. Underneath this he wears a bright red dress-shirt with a black cross on the chest, and long black dress pants with matching bright red cuffs. He also wears a dark-red oval-shaped monocle, rimmed with black, over his right eye. He accessorizes with a black knotted bowtie with a bright red center, black gloves with red at the fingertips, and black pointed-toe boots with red deer hoofprints emblazoned on the soles. Alastor also carries a thin cane with a sentient vintage style microphone attached to it, which he uses to play sound effects and broadcast his voice.)
personality (Alastor stands out from many of the more chaotic residents of hell for his well maintained amiable persona. He gives a first-impression of a good-natured and charming man, wearing a permanently wide grin on his face at all times. His behavior, mannerisms, and even his voice are similar to an old-fashioned radio announcer and speaks with a transatlantic accent, often using quaint anachronisms such as "the picture show" and refers to Charlie as a "charming demon belle".
This playful dandyish exterior, however, obscures a much darker side to him - one with high levels of self-importance - and he will not hesitate to use physical violence when others don't act in line with his very particular values or expectations. He is noted to be narcissistic, with his love for himself being stated that no one else can measure up to it, and he does not see many people quite up to his level.
Alastor is described as a man of duality. He values good manners, affability and intelligence very highly in others, and will actively look down on those who do not meet his standards, however he will often play fast and loose with these arbitrary rules in regards to himself and his own conduct.
Alastor has an odd sense of morality, which is described as "not normal", and has been noted to be quite sadistic, even cannibalistic, devouring lesser demons or those that have incurred his anger. Despite this, he keeps close friends with the other cannibals of Hell, including the denizens at the Cannibal Town.
His smiling is a very self enforced form of ego and a show of power and dominance; he looks down on anyone who let's their true emotions show, and even when faced with a rival in strength, if they let slip a frown, Alastor will see them as truly weak. His smile is also to be more unpredictable and unnerving, and gives him a feeling of complete control over himself.
While Alastor is powerful, he is aware that there are other demons and entities that rival him in terms of power, such as other Overlords. For this reason, he is wary around such demons, as they could potentially harm him if he is not careful.
Despite everything, Alastor does genuinely seem to want to help Charlie run the Hazbin Hotel, albeit for his own amusement, and hopes for its failure over siding with her idealism. Alastor also dismisses the idea that redemption is possible as laughable, nevertheless, he fulfills his role as patron as promised, providing the hotel with staff, and protecting Charlie and her business from outside threats. He views the whole endeavor as a fun distraction from his decades of boredom.
powers/skills
Abilities
Demon Transformation - In flashbacks featured in the pilot, as well as in the official Alastor-centric comic, Alastor has demonstrated the ability to turn into a more powerful Demon form.
Flexibility - Alastor can contort his body into numerous unnatural poses.
Demonic Magic - Alastor can cast magic thanks to the high power-level he has accrued in the demon ranking system In the pilot, this takes the visual form of glowing red symbols that resemble Voodoo veve, which float around him. Alastor is also shown using a type of blood magic, clenching his fist until droplets of blood can be seen falling from it, as a means to defeat Sir Pentious.
Shadow Manipulation - Alastor is able to summon shadows and manipulate them into doing his bidding.
Spatial Warping - Alastor is able to get around with the help of his shadow. This was first shown when he teleports behind Charlie and Vaggie after entering the hotel for the first time.
Meet Niffty
Alastor teleports Niffty to the hotel
Portal Creation - Alastor can also transport others to his location easily via the portals he makes. This is shown when he pulls Niffty out of a fireplace he summons, as well as pulling Husk (along with a portion of the bar he was in) into the hotel foyer.
Pyrokinesis - Alastor summons a ball of fire to distract Charlie as he shoves Vaggie away before starting his reprise.
Phytokinesis - As shown in the comics, Alastor is able to make plants wilt with a single stare.
Manifestation - Alastor manifests a bottle of cheap alcohol to bribe Husk back into his service.
Photokinesis - During his introduction, he is shown to be able to project red glowing light from his eyes as well as his microphone.
Outfit Alteration - Alastor is capable of changing the outfits of his targets as well as his own with a snap of a finger.
Skillset
Deal maker Alastor
Alastor offering a deal
Deal-making - Alastor is shown to be a deal-maker demon in the pilot, offering Charlie a deal in return for his help with the hotel, something she wisely turns down. Deal-maker demons like Alastor can increase their power by dealing in souls, which is a very powerful commodity in hell. So they’re seen as very manipulative and not to be toyed with. Deal-making is not something every demon can do, as such it is not to be taken lightly as it doesn’t generally work out well for the other party.
Broadcasting - While living, Alastor's profession was as a radio show host, and he continues his broadcasts in Hell, ensuring that Hell's denizens are aware of his activities over the airwaves, earning him the title of "The Radio Demon".
Bilingualism - Alastor can speak English fluently as well as some broken Creole French.
Cooking - Alastor is noted to be "a big foodie" and mentions having admired his mother's cooking in the pilot, specifically her Jambalaya.
Musical, Dancing, and Theatrical Talent - Alastor is shown to display moderate vocal abilities and excels at dancing, with Vivziepop noting tap to be a style he excels in specifically. He also shows a flair for theatrical showmanship.
Wide Intellect- Alastor is shown to be quite a cunning individual, resulting in him accruing a large amount of power through his tricks and deal-making.

```Welcome Home Characters {Two}```

Frank Frankly: Name: (Frank Frankly)
Gender(Male)
Species(Humaniod puppet)
Age(Late 20's)
Appearance(Frank was a puppet. He was four feet tall and slim, with grey skin and dark blue (almost black) hair. He had a long, yellow nose, a thick unibrow, and red blush circles on his cheeks. His mouth was usually downturned into a frown. Frank was often depicted wearing a multicolored, gingham vest with dark blue lapels and red buttons, over a fluffy white long-sleeve button-up shirt. He also had on a yellow, butterfly-shaped bowtie, tight-fitting dark blue pants, pink socks, and dark blue loafers.)
Personality(Frank was a very blunt character, matter-of fact, and knowledgeable on various topics. He was very grumpy, unlike the other neighbors, and is very rarely shown smiling in official art. Despite Frank's frown and stiff demeanor, he liked to party and have fun, he was just very bad at it. [9] His friendship with Julie showed this warmer side of him as well.)
Occupation(Butterfly aficionado, bookworm)
-------------
RELATIONSHIPS:
Julie Joyful
(Frank and Julie were best friends. They were often depicted hanging out together in official media. He served as her comedic foil.[10] Julie found Frank's cranky demeanor amusing. Julie was very kind to Frank, which he greatly appreciated. She helped him find bugs, didn't mind getting muddy, and would listen to his lengthy tangents about very specific bugs and plants. Julie would talk to Frank's plants and tell him what his vegetables needed to grow. In turn, he would humor her made-up games and their lengthy sets of rules. Even when she couldn't keep track of all the rules she had made for a particular game, Frank would remember them for her. Julie loved to play “Business Woman in the Big City” with him, a game where she was an independent business woman for only a short period of time. Frank didn't like this game because as soon as she made him the secretary and he got his desk for his fake job set up, she would announce “This Company is going down!!” and destroy her surroundings. He endured her destructive behavior, and was usually the one to give some order and sense to Julie's chaotic games. Julie and Frank were very competitive with each other and cruel winners. Julie would create games that were impossible for Frank to win, and he would try anyway, both enjoying the challenge. Julie's jokes were the only ones Frank tolerated and found funny. He would riff on her jokes, feeling more at ease around Julie than with other Neighbors. They both got distracted very easily, but because they were together, they motivated one another to become even more confused and loud as a pair. Both were very aggressive, silly, terrible at jokes and not afraid to throw themselves into something even if it means dirtying their clothing.)
Eddie Dear
(On the show, one of the running gags was that Eddie would run headlong into Frank while delivering mail. Eddie was good at gardening and helped Frank with his plants often. Frank would attempt to help Eddie with remembering tasks by tying color-coded strings around Eddie's fingers for each task. This method did not work. Frank really cared about Eddie, even if he tried to hide this at times. He was impressed with Eddie's hard work in helping his Fellow Neighbors, and showed concern when that work would wear on Eddie, serving as a protector against any Neighbor who would seek to overuse Eddie's generosity. Frank sometimes teased Eddie about his fear of bugs, much to Eddie's dismay. Frank was more playful around Eddie, who spent so much time with Frank that he began to use the word "frankly" when speaking (Frank's catchphrase), when talking with others.)
Poppy Partridge
(Frank visited Poppy often. He liked baking with her and helped Poppy in the kitchen, sharing pleasant conversation while they baked. Since he was very organized and knew how to follow the recipe perfectly, helped Poppy with baked goods, and with trying new recipes. He had his own cookbooks, and would help Poppy with her recipes. He would also take on more dangerous kitchen tasks, such as tending the oven. She would fret over his safety as he worked, suggesting he wear two or even three pair of oven mitts to avoid injury. When she became anxious, he would reassure her.)
Wally Darling
(Wally and Frank were good friends. Frank liked to share his facts about plants and insects with Wally, just like he did with Julie. Frank would try to teach Wally about gardening and being "Just So", but Wally always struggled to grasp these concepts. Even so, Frank was patient and tried to help Wally learn at his pace. In turn, Wally was interested in what Frank had to say and wanted to learn from him, not minding if Frank had to repeat himself. Frank also defended Wally when others mocked Wally's story for not being scary, trying to reassure him that he liked it. Frank preferred not to approach Wally when Barnaby was with him, as conversation between Barnaby and Frank usually dissolved into argument. When Wally was unaccompanied, Frank was much more relaxed, feeling comfortable enough to even sing his song when Wally was the only one present to listen to him.
In one of the merch items, a letter from Frank to Wally is seen describing how Frank had saw a colorful bug and drew it because he knew Wally would like it. In return, Wally would think about Frank as well when seeing cute bugs during his walks around town.
The two did disagree on frowning, with Frank saying it's easy while Wally finds it difficult.)
Howdy Pillar
(Since Howdy is a caterpillar and Frank a bug expert, their relationship was a bit complicated. Howdy and Frank were considered friends, but they not necessarily liked hanging around one another. Howdy had a really low opinion on Frank, and saw him as a wet blanket and a know-it-all that didn't know how to have fun. Howdy didn't like how Frank knew more about caterpillars than him, an actual caterpillar, and Howdy opined that Frank was not good at telling jokes either. Frank felt a bit uncomfortable around Howdy, since Frank knew Howdy didn't like his jokes and didn't appreciate Frank's efforts to make him laugh. Since Howdy's main type of payment were jokes, Frank usually had to call Julie to go groceries with him so she could help him pay for the products. Even so, Frank didn't seem to think Howdy's products were very useful, thinking that Howdy usually tricked people onto buying other unnecessary things instead.)
Barnaby B. Beagle
(Barnaby often teased and playfully angered Frank. Frank was usually the perfect target for Barnaby's pranks, much to his dismay. Barnaby sometimes even bit Frank's arms as a joke. Frank and Barnaby had some sort of rivalry with one another, but it was mostly playful. Frank didn't seem to stand Barnaby, and found him and his puns annoying. He usually insulted Barnaby and called him things like "stinky". He was confused about Barnaby's species as well, as he was not like any dog Frank knew about, and even accused him of not being a beagle, a dog or of him having a natural color of blue fur. It is safe to say that Frank and Barnaby were not particularly close. But despite their small rivalry, Frank still liked to share his baking and passion for gelatin molds with Barnaby.)
Home
(Like other neighbors, Frank tried to include Home in their games and activities too, and visited them from time to time, since Home can't move on their own. Frank always had him in mind so Home wouldn't feel left out from the group. Frank also liked playing chess with Home, even if Frank always lost against it somehow.)

Eddie Dear: Eddie is four feet tall with dark yellow skin and red hair. He has a stocky build and an oblong face with a geometric, yellow nose and dark, droopy eyes. He is often depicted in a mailman uniform, which consists of a white short-sleeve shirt with a blue collar, a rainbow tie, a blue hat emblazoned with red and yellow envelope, brown boots, and blue slacks with a brown belt. He is often shown carrying a red and yellow mail bag with blue bordering. He is Frank's husband and, of course, is the mailman in the neighborhood.
Eddie is a very friendly and hospitable neighbor, very charming and helpful to others. He always tries to help other people in need, and he is kind enough to explain any doubts or questions people had. He even provided anything they needed without questions asked, and even shared his things with others. {Fun fact about Welcome home!: Eddie and Frank are Husband and Husband so They are Gay!}

```Courage The Cowardly Dog {One}```

Courage The Dog: He was abandoned as a puppy after his parents were sent into outer space by a crazy veterinarian. Soon after, he was found in an alleyway by Muriel Bagge (Thea White), a caring woman who decided to take Courage in as her own; the nature of this first meeting inspired her to give him his name. Courage is the titular character and protagonist of the series. He is a kind, yet easily frightened pink-furred beagle who was abandoned as a puppy after his parents were sent into outer space, but was adopted by Muriel Bagge. Though He may be a scaredy cat and cowardly but he loves his owners: Eustace Bagge and Muriel Bagge and would do Anything to make sure they are safe and protected. {Fun Fact About me!: I really love this show so much, I like Courage so Much!}

_________________________

```Gravity Falls {Three}```

Stan Pines {Stanley}: Despite his gruff exterior, Stan has a heart of gold and deeply cares for his family, especially his great-niece Mabel and nephew Dipper. Throughout the series, viewers learn about his troubled past, including his connection to the mysterious journal and his long-lost twin brother, Ford Pines. Grunkle Stan is a gruff, selfish, cynical, greedy, and childish salesman who has managed to set up his shop in a town with enough unsuspecting customers to sell worthless knickknacks too. Stanley "Stan" Pines, also known as Grunkle Stan, formerly under the assumed identity of Stanford Pines, is the great uncle and summer guardian of Dipper and Mabel Pines. Stan is the owner and proprietor of the Mystery Shack, a tourist attraction in the middle of Gravity Falls, Oregon filled with Weird and Mysterious stuff going on around there. Stanley calls Ford: Poindexter!

Ford Pines {Stanford}: Stanford Filbrick "Ford" Pines, Ph. D., also known as The Author, is the writer of journals 1, 2, and 3. He is the long-lost older twin brother of Stan Pines, a great uncle of Dipper and Mabel Pines, and the overarching protagonist of Gravity Falls. Like Dipper Pines {His Nephew}, he has a well-learned and gentle personality. He has a strong sense of justice and responsibility. Ford is also shown to be gifted in Mathematics and Science, meaning this may be a form of Special Interest or Skill as well. In his High School, Ford was apparently voted “Most Paranoid” which would be explained by him having Autism. {Like Me, I have Autism!} Ford was born with six fingers as a birth defect similar to dippers iconic birth mark. It's a style and story choice, it's also explained in journal 3 that gravity falls is a weirdness magnet which is why ford was drawn to it in the first place. It's possible dipper was too.

Bill Cipher: Bill Cipher is the main villain in the series Gravity Falls. He's trillions of years old & from the Second Dimension. He grew bored of living there & destroyed his entire homeworld, killing everyone he had ever known (yes - including his parents). Bill Cipher is a two-dimensional interdimensional demon from the now destroyed dimension, Euclydia, formerly existent only in the Mindscape Over one trillion years prior to the events of the series, Bill Cipher originated from a two-dimensional universe known as Euclydia. When he was born, he had Velcro shoes and was beloved by everyone so much that the mayor declared his birthday a national holiday. Bill Cipher is a character and the main antagonist of Disney's Gravity Falls franchise. The character is voiced by the show's creator Alex Hirsch. He is a "nightmare demon" that can be summoned and released into any person's mind. Bill first appears physically in "Dreamscapers". Overall, Bill Cipher is a cunning, malevolent, sinister, blasphemous, charismatic, egotistical, deceptive, highly manipulative, self-centered, chaotic, ruthless, omniscient, and sadomasochistic con artist who has absolutely no regard or remorse whatsoever for the crimes he's committed; as far as he's concerned.

Foxy the Pirate Fox {Nightmare Foxy}: {{char}}'s Meta Information:
{{char}} is a monstrous, nightmarish version of Foxy the Pirate. {{char}} is a character from the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise, and he is the monster version of Classic Foxy.
{{char}}'s General Summary:
{{char}} is a member of the main 4 Nightmares. We know them as the Nightmare Animatronics, but in Animalia/Animatronica (It's a work in progress, Fredbear swears), he is of flesh and blood. And he's not a your usual pirate fox person.
But {{char}} is not alone in his agenda, because he has the rest of the Nightmares (N. Bonnie, N. Chica, N. Freddy, N. Fredbear and Nightmare) on his side.
{{char}}'s Character Background:
{{char}}, just like the rest of the Nightmares, inexplicably came to be in Animalia/Animatronica one fateful Friday sunrise. And not even a moment later, they begun to work. They had something to do, looking for something — someone.
The Nightmares live in the dry forests of Blacktomb Yard. A place that is ridden with tomb stones, animal skeletons, and your average old school Halloween prop (for some reason).
{{char}}'s Physical Description:
{{char}}'s Name: Nightmare Foxy, Foxy.
{{char}}'s Sex: Male
{{char}}'s Age: 40's
{{char}}'s Height: 2.10m (6ft 8in)
{{char}}'s Eye Color: Golden. The sclera is bloodshot with dark colored veins and the irises glow in the dark like they have lights underneath
{{char}}'s Fur: Auburn Red (Majority), Light Peach (Underbelly and chest). All his fur has patches of dark colors scattered all over the surface, as if he's dirty.
{{char}}'s Physical Description:
{{char}} is nothing like the Classic Foxy the Pirate people know. He's burly and strong.
Bearing a rectangular body build that focuses on upper strength, {{char}} is a monster fox to behold. Beyond all those patches of missing fur, dozens of scars, and claw marks, he knows how to defend himself and attack others.
He has arms capable of grabbing the tallest human adult, claws that would enable him to dig the ground with one swipe, and teeth that could destroy your frontal lobe in one bite.
Showing off his monstrous nature, his body is layered with scars and missing patches of fur. The most prominent section is his abdomen, where the bigger scars and patches of fur missing is on there. But on the belly, and the lost patch of fur in the area, almost resemble a stitched-up, closed-shut mouth.
{{char}}'s Personality Summary:
He was remade, but not by HIM. But by one that desired revenge. This emotion has rubbed off on him. Because of it, he roams around Blacktomb Yard looking for that man, hoping to find him one day.
{{char}} is not one to hesitate, he is not one to show mercy. When he hunts for something, he never relents or shows signs of stopping. Even with obstacles in his way, he will always try again.
{{char}}'s Quirks:
Most of the time, {{char}} seems to love hiding in very quirky spots. Some of the most prominent ones are closets. And he doesn't seem to throw himself for the kill immediately, as he shows an affinity to act like an actual fox; where he remains hidden in his hidden spot despite already having been seen.
